move-balloon.you: Advance your Hot-Air Balloon and place a Tile

move-balloon-last.you: Final turn: advance your Hot-Air Balloon and place a Tile

place-tile.you: Place the Tile in your Panorama
place-tile.player: {player} places a Tile in their Panorama

place-tile-last.you: Final turn: place the Tile in your Panorama

validate-tile.player: {player} places a Tile in their Panorama

tile.title: Panorama Tile
tile.intro: On their turn, the active player takes the top Tile of a pile and adds it to their <bold>Panorama</bold>.
tile.top: This Tile is on top of its pile: it can be taken.
tile.covered: This Tile is hidden under another Tile of the pile.
tile.mine: This Tile is part of your Panorama.
tile.owner: This Tile is part of {player}’s Panorama.

starting-tile.title: Starting Tile
starting-tile.intro: Each Panorama begins with the Starting Tile matching the colour of its Hot-Air Balloon. It splits the Panorama into <bold>2 sides</bold>, which some Objectives count.

placement.title: Placing a Tile
placement.side: Add the Tile <bold>to the left or right</bold> of the Tiles in your Panorama.
placement.between: You may not place a Tile <bold>in between 2 Tiles</bold> already there, nor move Tiles you’ve already placed.
placement.waves: The wavy edges must <bold>fit together</bold> snugly. Tiles may be offset, as long as they fit together properly.

zones.title: Terrain Zones
zones.zone: A <bold>Terrain Zone</bold> is any area of uninterrupted, orthogonally connected spaces with the same Terrain type. Diagonals do not count.
zones.score: At the end of the game, each Terrain Zone scores its number of <bold>Flowers</bold> multiplied by its number of <bold>Animals</bold>. Flowers with no Animal in their Zone score nothing.

1.title: Fewest clouds
1.rule: Have the <bold>fewest Clouds</bold> in your Sky. Sky spaces don’t need to be connected!

2.title: Most clouds on one side
2.rule: Have the <bold>most Clouds on one side</bold> of your Hot-Air Balloon (Starting Tile). Sky spaces don’t need to be connected!

3.title: Largest sky zone
3.rule: Have the <bold>largest Sky Zone</bold>. Sky spaces must be connected for this one!

4.title: Most tiles on one side
4.rule: Have the <bold>most Tiles on one side</bold> of your Hot-Air Balloon.

5.title: Longest river
5.rule: Have the <bold>longest River</bold>: the River that passes unbroken through the most Tiles.

6.title: Most animals next to the same river
6.rule: Have the <bold>most Animals next to the same River</bold>. Do not include Animals next to separate Rivers! Note: not all Animals are next to Rivers.

7.title: Most separate rivers
7.rule: Have the <bold>most separate Rivers</bold> that connect across at least 2 Tiles.

8.title: Most waterfalls in the same river
8.rule: Have the <bold>most Waterfalls in the same River</bold>. Do not include Waterfalls in separate Rivers!

9.title: Most crows
9.rule: Have the <bold>most Crows</bold> in your Panorama. Their Terrain Zones do not need to be connected.

10.title: Fewest tiles
10.rule: Have the Panorama with the <bold>fewest Tiles</bold>.

11.title: Most zones with an animal
11.rule: Have the <bold>most Terrain Zones containing at least 1 Animal</bold>. A Terrain Zone with multiple Animals counts as 1.

12.title: Fewest terrain zones
12.rule: Have the <bold>fewest Terrain Zones</bold>. Sky Zones do not count!

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.text: At the end of the game, the Objective awards <bold>{points} points</bold> to the Panorama that best meets it. In the case of a draw, each tied player scores {points} points.

objective.first-game: This Objective has a star: it is one of the 3 Objectives for your first game.

turn.title: Game turn
turn.whose: If your Hot-Air Balloon is at the same Location as the <bold>Sun token</bold>, it’s your turn:
turn.choose: <bold>Select a Tile</bold>: move your Hot-Air Balloon to a free Location (with no Sun or Hot-Air Balloon) and take the top Tile.
turn.place: <bold>Place the Tile</bold> to the left or right of your Panorama.
turn.sun: <bold>Advance the Sun</bold> clockwise to the next Hot-Air Balloon: its owner plays the next turn.
turn.order: The turn order therefore changes during the game: you may even play 2 or 3 turns in a row. But if you move your Hot-Air Balloon far ahead, you could end up waiting a long time before playing again.

end.title: End of game
end.trigger: When a player takes <bold>the last Tile on a Location</bold> and places it in their Panorama, they deflate their Hot-Air Balloon: their flight is over and they will not play any more turns.
end.moon: The Sun token is flipped to its <bold>Moon</bold> side and advances to the next Hot-Air Balloon. The player whose Hot-Air Balloon is with the Moon takes their <bold>final turn</bold>, deflates their Hot-Air Balloon, then advances the Moon.
end.score: When all Hot-Air Balloons are deflated, it’s time for <bold>scoring</bold>: Terrain Zones, then Objectives.

balloon.title: Hot-Air Balloon
balloon.mine: Your <bold>Hot-Air Balloon</bold>. It advances clockwise from pile to pile to select your Tiles.
balloon.player: {player}’s <bold>Hot-Air Balloon</bold>. It advances clockwise from pile to pile to select their Tiles.
balloon.deflated: This Hot-Air Balloon is deflated: its flight is over.

sun.title: Sun token
sun.intro: The <bold>Sun</bold> shows whose turn it is: the player whose Hot-Air Balloon is at the same Location.

moon.title: Moon token
moon.intro: The <bold>Moon</bold> shows that the end of the game has been triggered: the player whose Hot-Air Balloon is with it takes their final turn.

centrepiece.title: Centrepiece
centrepiece.intro: The <bold>{players}-player</bold> Centrepiece has {stacks} sides. In front of each side is a face-up pile of {size} Tiles.

stacks.title: The piles
stacks.top: Only the <bold>top Tile</bold> of a pile is visible. It can be taken if neither a Hot-Air Balloon nor the Sun is at that pile.
stacks.sunrise: The Sun token starts next to the pile in line with the <bold>Sunrise symbol</bold>. Hot-Air Balloons are placed at random, one per pile, starting from that one in clockwise direction.
stacks.end: When a player takes <bold>the last Tile on a Location</bold>, the end of the game is triggered.

tutorial.panorama: Over the course of your Hot-Air Balloon journey, you will gradually build your Panorama, made of Panorama Tiles. You start with this Starting Tile.
tutorial.move-balloon: You are playing the blue Hot-Air Balloon <balloon/>. Advance your Hot-Air Balloon to here.
tutorial.place-tile:
Now take the Tile in front of your Hot-Air Balloon and place it in your Panorama, to the left or right of your Starting Tile.
Here, place it to the right, at the same height: it extends your River.
tutorial.waves: As you can see, the Tiles have wavy edges: Tiles can be placed at different heights, but they must fit together snugly.
tutorial.sun: Your turn is over: the Sun token is now alone. It advances clockwise to the next Hot-Air Balloon: it’s that player’s turn.
tutorial.gap: Your opponent left an empty space: if you advance your Hot-Air Balloon to here, you will play twice in a row.
tutorial.flowers: At the end of the game, you will score Terrain points. Flowers earn you points, but only if they are in the same Terrain Zone as at least one Animal . Each Animal scores 1 point per Flower in its Terrain Zone.
tutorial.zones: A Terrain Zone is any area of uninterrupted Terrain of the same type, connected orthogonally. Diagonals do not count.
tutorial.zones-example: Forest A will score 2 points (2 × 1 ). Forest B will score no points (1 × 0 ).
tutorial.objectives: In addition, 3 Objectives are in play. Each one awards 10 points to the Panorama that best meets it. The Objectives for your first game are:
tutorial.objectives-tie: In the case of a draw, both players score the 10 points.
tutorial.help: On Game Park, you can always click on any game element for a reminder of its rules: try clicking on an Objective, for example!
tutorial.free-turn: Now advance your Hot-Air Balloon and place the Tile however you like: try to make the most of your Terrains by gathering as many Animals <animals/> and Flowers <flowers/> as possible, while keeping an eye on the Objectives!
tutorial.end:
The game continues like this until a pile of Tiles is empty: every other player then plays one final turn. The player with the most points wins.
Enjoy the journey!
